'''Sap''' is a [[:Category:Foraging|foraged]] item that drops from [[trees]] when they are cut down. It is used in various [[crafting]] recipes. Sap can be consumed, however it decreases [[energy]] by 2 points.

Sap may also be obtained from tapping [[Mahogany Tree]]s and all [[Slimes]] except [[Slimes#Big Slimes|Big Slimes]].

[[Vincent]] sells a Sap in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|1|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]].

==Bundles==
Five hundred Sap are required in the {{Bundle|Sticky||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Sap is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt006|link=Tailoring{{!}}Tan Striped Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a yellow dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the yellow dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
Sap is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trading==
Once unlocked, the Raccoon's wife near the [[Giant Stump]] will trade for Sap.
